board.name: Nebraska DHHS Licensure Unit, Board of Medicine and Surgery (Physician Assistant)

ce.categoryRules: Either 50 hours of Category 1 CME (ACCME, AOA or AAPA approved) earned in the 24 months before expiration (up to 25 hours may carry over), OR meet NCCPA re-registration requirements in those 24 months.

topicMandates.topic: Prescribing opiates (includes 0.5 hour on the Nebraska PDMP)
topicMandates.period: every cycle (biennially) through the 2027 PA renewal
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs who prescribe controlled substances; Neb. Rev. Stat. 38-145(6) terminates Jan 1, 2029, so the Oct 1, 2027 PA renewal is the last one it reaches (statute date; DHHS PA page gives no end date)

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 3 hours opiate prescribing CE every 2 years (0.5 hour PDMP) for controlled substance prescribers, Neb. Rev. Stat. 38-145(6).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Supervising physician must be party to a collaborative agreement with the PA, kept on file at the primary practice site and each practice site, produced to the board or DHHS on request. Not filed routinely; no renewal interval stated.
practice.notes: Supervision is continuous but does not require physical presence; a supervising physician may supervise no more than four PAs at a time (waiver possible). PA needs a supervising physician for each employer and each specialty area in a multispecialty practice. Nebraska enacted the PA Licensure Compact (LB 1215, signed April 2, 2024).

prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 3 hours opiate prescribing CE per biennial renewal (0.5 hour PDMP), Neb. Rev. Stat. 38-145(6).

board.name: Nebraska DHHS Licensure Unit, Nebraska State Board of Nursing / APRN Board

rn.ceNotes: One of several continued competency options: 500 practice hours in 5 years AND 20 contact hours in 2 years; or a refresher course in 5 years; or current national nursing specialty certification; or a portfolio. New licensees within 24 months are waived.

aprn.title: APRN-NP (Nurse Practitioner licence; uses title NP)
aprn.ceNotes: No CE hour total for the APRN-NP licence. Renewal requires current national certification in the NP specialty and, if licensed more than five years, 2,080 NP practice hours in the previous five years (these hours also satisfy the RN practice-hour requirement under 38-2319(1)).

topicMandates.appliesTo: NPs who prescribe controlled substances; 2020 through 2028 renewals

prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 3 hours opiate prescribing CE per renewal (0.5 hour PDMP) for controlled substance prescribers, 2020 through 2028 renewals.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: 2,000 hours of initial practice under a formal written transition-to-practice agreement with a supervising provider (physician, osteopathic physician, or NP with 10,000 hours) in the same or related specialty. The agreement itself is not submitted to DHHS unless requested; DHHS requires an 'Attestation of Supervision' form only when the supervising provider is an NP. No ongoing agreement after the 2,000 hours. NPs licensed on or before Aug 30, 2015 with 2,000 physician-supervised hours are exempt.
